rows.text: In the depths of Loukas' prison, your cellmate is hatching a "precise" jailbreak plan.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: As punishment for assassinating the tyrant, everyone here will be cast into the arena to be fed to the lions the next time Aquila opens their eyes.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Oronyx above, we offer all we have in exchange for our lives. Before the tyrant pushes us onto the gallows in their wrath, may you grant us a miracle to deliver us, your humbled disciples." You all place your worldly possessions on the tray, even gold teeth.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Perhaps Oronyx is still dreaming? Or are there too many people praying to them? How about trying the other two Fate Titans?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Show your originality and pray to Talanton.
Sharp shadows shred the prison's stone walls, piercing winds chill to the bone — the Scale of Justice's blessing ends here.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The Scale of Justice's blessing always comes at a cost. The instant the prison gates swing open, the patrolling guards catch sight of you as well.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Beneath the Veil of Evernight, time shows you the ancient past, an era without prisons or tyrants. The prison's stone walls crumble before your eyes, and you all stride freely into the world beyond.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A faint sliver of light engulfs your offerings, swallowed by the gaping chasm on the prison floor. A raging river surges below, but leaping in seems the much better option than waiting to die here.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Amidst low whispers that bridge the divide, the blessing of the Gate of Infinity reveals itself to you. The once-sealed prison opens itself, and all who were imprisoned here by the tyrant see the mesmerizing night sky.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
